_notes: Default gate ceilings for score_batch.py --thresholds. These are starting points: they pass carefully edited prose and fail drafts full of hard tells. Copy this file and tune the numbers from your own published writing. Formatting-density features are listed in _warn_only: they print a warning and never fail the gate, so a gate never pushes anyone to strip headings, lists or bold. Language-tell ceilings still block.
